title: Used product sent.
text: Used product sent.. Good quality rod. But I ordered and paid for a new product. The rod I received had been opened and re-taped with duct tape. The instructions were missing and half the hangers were off the rod but they were loose in the box.

product_metadata.title: Rod Desyne Heavy Duty Adjustable Traverse Rod, 30 x 48
features: Rod Desyne is pleased to introduce our Heavy Duty White Traverse Rod. This rod will add alluring style and refined touch to your window treatment and home decor.
Includes 1 white traverse rod, 2 end brackets, 1 support and 10 sliders
